Element.attribute:
Responsible for the planning, design, automation and execution of testing activities as well as the identification, prioritization and remediation of defects.

The testing workstream typically performs validation testing, system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, performance testing and user acceptance testing (UAT). Unit testing is performed by the developers and security and controls testing and data conversion testing is performed by the respective workstreams.

develop_test_strategy
Element.attribute: Provide direction for the overall testing effort, identify the environments that will be needed and define the process for tracking and addressing defects discovered throughout the testing effort.

Element.Name: establish_test_automation_framework
Element.attribute: Identify the specific test cases that can be automated and prepare the associated test scripts. Additionally, define the test data requirements and identify the environment(s) that will be used for automated testing.

Element.Name: execute_validation_testing
Element.attribute: Plan, design, prepare for and execute end of cycle validation testing and address the defects.

Element.Name: plan_design_tests
Element.attribute: Plan for end of cycle validation testing and design test cases and scripts.

Element.Name: manage_defects
Element.attribute: Log and track defects based on the defect management process and standards.

Element.attribute: Plan for system integration testing (SIT) cycles 1 through n based on the test strategy and design the test scenarios, cases and scripts as well as the data requirements for conducting the tests.

Element.Name: plan_design_tests
